clinicalPearls: Unilateral adult tonsil enlargement means cancer pathway
Secondary post tonsillectomy bleed at 5 to 10 days
reference.pathophysiology: Streptococcal pharyngitis triggers immune sequelae in susceptible hosts, while peritonsillar spread breaches capsule planes; adenotonsillar lymphoid hypertrophy peaks physiologically in childhood narrowing airway relative to skeletal growth.
additionalDifferentials: Quinsy versus peritonsillar cellulitis (pus proven by aspiration)
Streptococcal versus EBV tonsillitis (rash, spleen, lymphocytes)
Obstructive hypertrophy versus recurrent infection indications
additionalInvestigations: Centor scoring and rapid antigen or culture by local policy
Aspiration yield for quinsy pus confirmation
Sleep study when apnoea severity uncertain

figures.alt: A composite image showing three conditions: a peritonsillar abscess causing uvula deviation, an enlarged adenoid in the nasopharynx, and an adult tonsil with unilateral enlargement.
figures.caption: Key pathologies: peritonsillar abscess with uvula deviation, adenoid hypertrophy, and unilateral tonsil enlargement. Illustration: StewardMD original.
